source_evidence: Player exact 'continue' after prior OOC critique of overly easy 2500gp Defense of Caereth quest and standing confirmed invitation to D316 defense consultation, resumes planned engagement. Do not replay/alter completed quest; retain earned rewards. Routine hosted dinner/evening and secure uninterrupted overnight, no personal expenditure or pack ration depletion; automatic pre-rest Psi Recovery as standing D245-246 rule: Psi5→6/6 and feature1→0, then actual qualifying full LR at dawn D316 after weighted5+2≥6, reset0/6, full pools and feature readiness; no RNG. V and Elara attend D316 consultation as invited speakers; companions remain safely at residence, no new movement of evidence/custody. Councillor convenes senior military, royal and Assembly representatives for previously offered meeting. Their plausible policy debate draws on world/politics/human-states.md and veyr-regional-security.md: Ossent and Crownsunder rival claims, cautious warning exchanges, defense coordination debated, Articles of Recognition constrain Crown powers, no formal alliance or legislative decision enacted. Councillor solicits V's view on lawful limited cross-border intelligence and safeguards against appropriation, no unchosen speech or outcome. Player's OOC feedback 'Wow that was outrageously easy to do for 2500 gold' is durable future design guidance only: appropriately substantial opposition/competing objectives/risk for major rewards, diplomatic solutions remain valid and no retroactive reward changes. D316~14:00 Caereth palace defense consultation, V and Elara present as invited speakers, not voting delegates. Other party members remain at secure Rethwyn city residence nearby with coach/horses and custody unchanged. V and Elara hosted at residence D315 evening, no V cost or pack ration/feed decrement while hosted. Before qualifying rest standing player Psi Recovery instruction triggers once: Psi5→6/6, Psi Recovery1→0, then quiet secure overnight D315→316 weighted LR5+2 reaches6 threshold, full LR completed at dawn, reset weighted rest0/6 (no excess carry or duplicate recovery). V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Food21/feed28, purse2903gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp loot offer unpaid, three early silver items unverified. Crown commission remaining300+1300 contingent. Kestrel originals V, Mara notes, Fenar exhibits, Crown certified copies unchanged. No confirmed reply from Severin. Councillor convenes previously invited defense consultation with royal advisers, Assembly representatives and military officer. They debate whether to coordinate border intelligence with Ossent despite rivalry/competing claims, and whether to centralize emergency defense powers; no decision, policy or military deployment yet. V and Elara have opportunity to contribute; councillor asks V's view on limited intelligence cooperation with Ossent and what safeguards would prevent military overreach, particularly after yesterday's guild agreement. No unchosen V political position, additional House promises, secret evidence disclosure beyond already authorized confidential Crown sharing, or new quest commitment. Await V response. Player latest OOC feedback on previous quest: rewards should reflect credible opposition, scope, risk and meaningful stakes; peaceful solutions still legitimate, no retroactive reduction of earned Defense reward. Dice delegated until stop.
